बॉलीवुड की सबसे धांसू पार्टी में अंदर क्या-क्या हुआ, इसका पूरा सच अब बाहर आ चुका है! 🪔✨

पत्रकार Namrata Zakaria ने 11 November को अपने Rolla आर्टिकल में बताया कि 5 November 2026 को Mumbai के Pali Hill वाले घर में Manish Malhotra की ग्रैंड दिवाली पार्टी हुई। बाहर पार्किंग में 80 से 100 paparazzi तैनात थे, वहीं अंदर 300 से 350 खास मेहमान मौजूद थे।

रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, Aishwarya Rai और Abhishek Bachchan की केमिस्ट्री ने सबका ध्यान खींचा। लेकिन सबसे दिलचस्प बात SRK यानी Shah Rukh Khan की रही! वो हमेशा बैक गेट से एंट्री लेते हैं। उनके बॉडीगार्ड Ravi Singh दूर से फोटो खींचने वाले मेहमानों से फोटो डिलीट करने की गुज़ारिश करते हैं। दावा है कि अगर किसी ने गलती से भी उनकी फोटो या वीडियो पोस्ट कर दी, तो समझो मनीष की पार्टी का यह उनका आखिरी न्योता था!

आर्टिकल के अनुसार, घर की दूसरी मंज़िल पर बने सोफे वाले VIP कॉर्नर में Salman Khan पूरी रात बैठते हैं, जहाँ Madhuri Dixit भी उनसे मिलने लाइन में लगती हैं। सलमान के जाने के बाद Aishwarya Rai से मिलने भी एक्टर्स लाइन लगाते हैं। वहीं SRK पहली बार मिलने वालों को भी प्यार से गले लगाते हैं और हाथ पर किस करते हैं, बस फोटो खिंचवाना सख्त मना है! 🤫

वैसे, SRK के इस नो-फोटो वाले रूल पर आपकी क्या राय है? हमें कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 💬

ctx.title: Shah Rukh's secret entry, 100 photographers outside, 350 guests inside, Aishwarya's corner: What really went down at Manish Malhotra's Diwali party
ctx.summary: Manish Malhotra's Diwali party brought together around 300 guests, including Shah Rukh Khan, Kareena Kapoor, Akshay Kumar and a host of other Bollywood stars.
ctx.text:
For the past five or six days, it has been everywhere on our social media feeds. Who wore what ? Who was with whom? Who arrived together? Who posed together? The inside pictures, the Instagram Reels, the paparazzi shots, the photoshoots in extravagant desi outfits. Also read | Nita Ambani's diamond ear cuffs and sheer crystal blouse are the real stars of her chic Manish Malhotra Diwali party look
We have all seen glimpses of Manish Malhotra's Diwali party , even if we were not invited. And we have all had questions. And finally, now, somebody who was actually there has decided to write about it. That person is Namrata Zakaria, the editor of Rolla. She was at the party on November 5, 2026, at Manish's residence in Mumbai , and here is what she shared in a November 11 Rolla article.
A post shared by Manish Malhotra (@manishmalhotra05)
According to Namrata, the fashion designer and longtime Bollywood insider usually has 400 people in his five-story home in Pali Hill. This year, he tried to limit his guest list to 200, but couldn't manage less than 300. The entrance to his home is a parking lot, which had a decorated wall as a backdrop for nearly 80 to 100 paparazzi.
Manish's Diwali parties always grab attention online. This year, it was the loved-up appearance of Aishwarya Rai and Abhishek Bachchan that created much of the buzz. Other guests included Kareena Kapoor and Saif Ali Khan, Nita Ambani, Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna, Karan Johar, Madhuri Dixit, Kajol, Kriti Sanon, Malaika Arora, Jahnvi Kapoor, Ananya Panday.
A post shared by Manish Malhotra (@manishmalhotra05)
Shah Rukh Khan (SRK) always appears from the back entrance of the house and avoids being photographed even when inside, Namrata wrote. The actor's personal bodyguard, Ravi Singh, reportedly politely requests that guests delete any photos they may have taken from afar. If you are one of those guests whom he has missed asking, and you end up posting a photo or a video of SRK, expect that to be your last invitation to Manish's Diwali party, she added.
A post shared by Manish Malhotra (@manishmalhotra05)
The party takes place on the second floor of Manish's home, Namrata reported – this is where a giant living room and dining room are, attached to two terraces on either side. In another section are the bar and the entertainment room, with its own separate terrace. This floor can comfortably house 300-350 people, Namrata wrote.
The hautest and haughtiest section is the living room, the corner of which is lined with plush white sofas, she added. If it's Salman Khan one evening, Salman will remain here for the entire duration of the party, and everyone queues up to greet him, even including Madhuri Dixit, she said. Aishwarya Rai is reportedly seated here too, and after Salman leaves, most of the other actors line up to say hello to her. Shah Rukh and Gauri are always seated here, according to Namrata. SRK reportedly greets everyone with a warm hug and a kiss on the hand, even if he has met you for the first time – just no pictures, please.
